description: Represents the position of the redaction

adfPointer.description: The ADF pointer indicating the position of the text to be redacted. This is only required when redacting from rich text(ADF) fields. For plain text fields, this field can be omitted.

expectedText.description: The text which will be redacted, encoded using SHA256 hash and Base64 digest

from.description: The start index(inclusive) for the redaction in specified content

to.description: The ending index(exclusive) for the redaction in specified content
